_leia: Frases das páginas escritas pelo código (src/lib/pages.mjs): contactos, perguntas, orçamento, cesto, pagamento, revendedores, e as frases dos marcadores das páginas legais. A origem é pt/; esta é a tradução inglesa. As que levam marcação têm as mesmas etiquetas nas duas línguas.
envios.nenhum: We are not shipping anywhere yet.
iva: VAT is not charged: article 53 of the Portuguese VAT code applies.
contacto.entrada: Ask us anything. We answer in a day, usually less.
contacto.whatsapp: The fastest way to reach us
contacto.oficina: The workshop is in {cidade}, {pais}. It is a workshop rather than a shop, so come by arrangement — send a message first.
contacto.mapaAviso: This loads Google Maps, which means your browser contacts Google and Google may set cookies. Nothing else on this site does that.
faq.prazo.resposta:
A lamp that is in stock leaves the workshop in {dias}. If it is out of stock you can still order it: we make yours, and it is with you in {semanas}. Each product page says which it is.

Cathelier pieces are always made to order — {semanas}, counted from when you approve the drawing. If one thing in an order is made to order, the whole order ships together.
faq.nome: Can I have a name on it?
faq.nome.resposta:
Yes, on anything, and it costs nothing extra. Put it in the engraving box on the product page — a name, a date, or a short phrase.

One thing to know: a piece with a name on it is made for you alone, so it cannot be returned under the 14-day rule. Choosing a colour we already offer is not personalisation and does not affect your right to cancel.
faq.seguranca: Is it safe in a baby’s room?
faq.seguranca.resposta:
These are decorative night lights, not toys. They are made of solid pine with water-based paints and every edge is sanded by hand, but they are not tested as toys and should not be handed to a small child to play with.

If it is going in a cot room, keep the cable out of the cot. Everything about care and safety.
faq.pilhas.resposta: Both, at the same price. The battery version takes two AA cells, which are not included. The mains version comes with a remote that dims it, times it and makes it pulse.
faq.portes.resposta: It depends where you are. The full table is here.
faq.desistir.resposta: You have {dias} days on anything that is not personalised. How it works.
faq.quantidade.resposta: Yes — favours, place cards, corporate gifts, club trophies. Ask for a quote and say roughly how many.
orcamento.entrada: For anything made to measure, or in quantity — a cake topper with two names, the signs for a wedding, favours for a christening, trophies for a season.
orcamento.texto: Tell us what you have in mind and, if it is more than one, roughly how many. We will come back with a price and a date. There is no form to fight with: a message is enough.
orcamento.whatsapp: Send a photo of what you have in mind
orcamento.ajuda.para: What it is for, and the date it is needed by.
orcamento.ajuda.palavras: The names, dates or words that go on it — or just say "50 different names".
orcamento.ajuda.imagem: Any picture of something close to what you want.
orcamento.passos.preco: We answer with a price and a date.
orcamento.passos.desenho: You approve a drawing. Nothing is cut before that.
orcamento.passos.fazemos: We make it, and it comes to you ready to give.

cesto.stockInsuficiente: There are not enough in stock for these quantities.
cesto.ifthenpay: Payments are handled by ifthenpay. We never see your card, your bank or your MB WAY PIN.
metodo.mbway.nota: You get the request on your phone and accept it there. Takes a minute.
metodo.mb.nota: We give you an entity and a reference to pay at an ATM or in home banking.
metodo.cartao.nota: Visa or Mastercard. You type the number on a secure page — we never see it.
metodo.google.nota: Pay with the card in your Google account.
metodo.apple.nota: Pay with Touch ID or Face ID on your Apple device.
naoEncontrada.texto: The page you were looking for has moved or never existed.
encomenda.referencia: Your order is {ref}. Keep that reference: it is what we both use if you write to us.
encomenda.confirmacao: A confirmation is on its way to your inbox, with when to expect it. The workshop starts now, and we will tell you when it ships.
encomenda.naoEncontrada: We could not find that order. If you have just paid, give it a minute and reload this page.
encomenda.escreva: If it stays like this, write to us — nothing will be charged twice.
obrigado.porPagar: We have not received the payment yet, and that is normal if you chose a Multibanco reference — it is yours for {dias}. Nothing is made and nothing is charged until you pay it.
obrigado.quandoChegar: The moment it reaches us we write to you, and the workshop starts. If you have just paid, give it a minute and reload this page.
pagar.mbway.texto: We sent a payment request to your phone. Open MB WAY, check the amount, and accept it.
pagar.mbway.aviso: Leave this page open — it changes by itself the moment you accept. If the request expires, you can order again and choose a Multibanco reference instead.
pagar.mb.como: At an ATM choose Pagamentos e outros serviços → Pagamentos de serviços, or use your bank’s app or home banking.
pagar.mb.validade: The reference is yours for {dias}, until {data}. Nothing is made and nothing is charged until you pay it.
pagar.mb.depois: The moment the payment reaches us we write to you and the workshop starts. You can close this page — we have the reference in your email too.
pagar.expirou.texto: Nothing was charged. Your basket is still here, so you can order again — and if MB WAY is being awkward, a Multibanco reference always works.
pagar.ifthenpay: Payments are handled by {ifthenpay}, a Portuguese payment institution. We never see your card, your bank or your MB WAY PIN.
cancelada.entrada: You left the payment page, so we have not taken anything and the order has not gone through.
cancelada.texto: If you were given a Multibanco reference before you left, it may still be valid — paying it will confirm the order. Otherwise your basket is still here if you want to pick it up again.
revenda.entrada: If we have registered you as a reseller, sign in here to see your price next to the retail price on every piece, and to buy at it.
revenda.outroDispositivo: Got the code on another device?
revenda.manter: Keep me signed in on this device
revenda.aindaNao: Not a reseller yet? Talk to us. Reseller purchases follow the reseller conditions.
revenda.precos: Retail prices are recommended retail prices — you set your own. The discount comes off each piece; paid options are at their normal price.
